items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I think you were talking to Houston Person earlier about if you just fall into it or what.

ctx.x: By this time was music your career? I mean you said okay, I’m going to be a musician now. This is something I can do.

I suppose so. I think you were talking to Houston Person earlier about if you just fall into it or what. I think I actually just kind of fell into it because the older brothers kind of led the way, you know, and the trombone was there, and you might as well play it, it’s there, you know. And let’s see, I don’t know. I could take up the whole story before I get to be 18 years old I guess.
Well, we’ve got some specific questions to ask about some of the big groups later on that you played with. Were you influenced by recordings?
